scenes.text: The hallway light flickered out at 23:41, casting the house in deep shadow. A cold breath brushed against the doorframe as the kitchen’s motion sensor twitched at 00:06.
The kitchen grew unnaturally cold by 00:07, the temperature plummets to 17°C. The radio crackled to life at 00:09, playing a melody that seemed to hum from the walls.
At 00:13, the hallway light flared back on, revealing the kitchen door ajar. The radio’s hum dissolved into silence, leaving only the faint echo of a whisper: 'You’re home.'

events.text: 00:06 — Motion detected in the empty kitchen.
00:07 — Kitchen temperature dropped from 21 to 17 degrees.
00:09 — Radio switched on with no station selected.
